<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown app --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown app [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--no-window`
: Only make sure the background service runs (for starting at login).

`--print`
: Print the browser command instead of running it.

`--browser <BROWSER>`
: A Chromium-family browser to use (default: Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave, whichever is installed; else your default browser). Also read from `$BACKDOWN_BROWSER`.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Finds the running background service (yours, or on Linux the machine-wide one) or starts one: the installed service if there is one, else a daemon of its own, logging to `daemon.log` in your data folder. The window is Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave in app mode, with a profile of its own (`app-window` in your data folder) that remembers its size and place; without one, a tab in your default browser. It opens with a one-time code, so the session token never goes on a command line. If BackDown's window is open already, it's brought forward.

## Examples

```sh
backdown app
# only make sure the background service runs (for starting at login)
backdown app --no-window
# a particular Chromium-family browser
backdown app --browser /usr/bin/chromium
```
